why: phase-515 R10 stage 1b (2026-10-27): the executor's node-id-keyed parameter forms left the Rust user surface (behind the sealed `nros_node::executor::ffi::ExecutorFfi`, as R9 stage 1 did for the C-shaped entry points), so the node is the one user-facing parameter receiver, as rclrs's is. `Node::set_parameter_local` forwards to `Executor::set_parameter_local_on(node_id, ...)`; the store is still the executor's one table (phase-426 W1). rclc's LOCAL typed set (phase-491 W2, RFC-0105 D7): type and on-set hooks are checked, read-only and range are not. rclrs has no such verb; `rust:Node::set_parameter` is the remote-rules set. Test: `packages/core/nros-node/src/executor/tests.rs` (`the_node_carries_the_whole_parameter_surface`).
